name: The resident sees exactly what the admin sees for the same unit
title: SC-13-02-02 The resident sees exactly what the admin sees for the same unit
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F4
When tenant "Selin Demir" signs in
Then her dashboard shows principal 1500.00, late fee 100.00, total 1600.00 and 40 days overdue
And the admin unit workspace of "A-2" shows the same three numbers
